newsitem.title: FINLAND: Amer rises on share equalisation news.
newsitem.headline: Amer rises on share equalisation news.

text.p: Shares in Finnish sporting goods group Amer-yhtyma Oy rose sharply on Tuesday after the company said it would propose to shareholders that all its unlisted K-shares would be converted into listed A-shares, brokers said.
"The reason (for the rise) is that they said they would combine their K- and A-shares," one broker said.
At 1325/1025 GMT, Amer traded at 100.00 markka, up 7.00 markka or seven percent, in lively 2.8 million markka volume after trade in the share had been suspended all morning.
One broker said that some investors might be speculating that the news that K- and A-series shares were to be combined was a first step in a move to sell the company.
